# User Notifications Epic Breakdown

## Questions I'd Ask the PM (with assumptions)

1. **What events trigger notifications?** → Assuming: account changes, activity mentions, system alerts
2. **Which channels?** → Assuming: in-app, email, push (mobile)
3. **User preferences needed?** → Assuming: yes, per-channel opt-in/out
4. **Real-time required?** → Assuming: in-app real-time, email can be batched
5. **Notification history?** → Assuming: yes, viewable in-app
6. **Rate limiting?** → Assuming: prevent spam, digest options

---

## User Stories

### 1. Technical Enabler: Notification Infrastructure
**As a** developer, **I want** a notification service foundation, **so that** all notification features have consistent infrastructure.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Notification data model exists (id, user_id, type, content, read_status, created_at)
- Database table/collection created with proper indexes
- Service layer with create/read/update operations
- API endpoints: GET /notifications, PATCH /notifications/:id/read

**Points:** 5 | **Dependencies:** None

---

### 2. In-App Notification Display
**As a** user, **I want** to see notifications in the app, **so that** I'm aware of important activity.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Notification bell icon in header with unread count badge
- Dropdown/panel shows last 20 notifications
- Clicking notification marks it read and navigates to relevant content
- "Mark all read" button available
- Works on web and mobile clients

**Points:** 5 | **Dependencies:** Story 1

---

### 3. Real-Time Notification Delivery
**As a** user, **I want** notifications to appear instantly, **so that** I don't miss time-sensitive information.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- WebSocket connection established on app load
- New notifications appear without page refresh
- Badge count updates in real-time
- Connection reconnects automatically if dropped

**Points:** 5 | **Dependencies:** Story 2

---

### 4. Email Notification Channel
**As a** user, **I want** to receive email notifications, **so that** I'm informed even when not in the app.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Email sent within 5 minutes of triggering event
- Email contains notification content and link to app
- Unsubscribe link in footer
- Emails use existing user email addresses

**Points:** 3 | **Dependencies:** Story 1

---

### 5. Notification Preferences
**As a** user, **I want** to control which notifications I receive, **so that** I'm not overwhelmed.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Settings page with notification preferences
- Toggle per notification type (mentions, system, activity)
- Toggle per channel (in-app, email)
- Preferences persist and are respected by notification service

**Points:** 3 | **Dependencies:** Stories 1, 4

---

### 6. Notification History
**As a** user, **I want** to view all past notifications, **so that** I can find information I may have missed.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Full notification history page (paginated, 50 per page)
- Filter by read/unread status
- Filter by notification type
- Search by content

**Points:** 3 | **Dependencies:** Story 2

---

## Prioritized Implementation Order

| Sprint 1 (18 pts) | Sprint 2 (6 pts) |
|-------------------|------------------|
| 1. Infrastructure (5) | 5. Preferences (3) |
| 2. In-App Display (5) | 6. History (3) |
| 3. Real-Time (5) | |
| 4. Email (3) | |

This sequence delivers core value first, with preferences and history as enhancements.
